span.p:
Is the respondent pool
and sample size disclosed?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Treat as directional/marketing
only -- do not cite as a target

span.p:
Is the sample self-selected
(opt-in survey, vendor's
own customer list)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Assume upward skew toward
larger, more mature orgs (S3)

span.p:
